title: Keys and doorways illustration
slide_intent: Use a spatial metaphor to introduce rules about access. A key and several keyholes give the reader a concrete image before the governance text begins.
strategic_value: Slack can keep a policy section within the same illustrated world as its design examples.
demonstration: Blue planes, cream passages and sharply angled black shadows form a room-like composition. Keyholes recur in the panels, with a loose key in the foreground.
practical_value: Choose a compact set of objects that conveys the section’s subject and can carry the entire page without a caption.

content_islands.name: Passages and keyholes
content_islands.spec: Fill the page with overlapping cream and blue planes. Cut keyholes into the raised panels and use angular shadows to separate planes.

content_islands.name: Foreground key
content_islands.spec: Place a blue key near the bottom of the scene with its dark offset shadow. Keep open cream space around it to distinguish the object.
